final_message:
I cleaned the data by removing 5 duplicate order events (keeping the first occurrence of each order id). I normalized the category names by trimming spaces and converting to lowercase. I converted the total field to a float, handling strings with commas, and excluded orders with total = -1 (missing total) from revenue calculations. I converted all placed_at timestamps to UTC to determine the month and year correctly.
